mapper.update: update sys_cloud_push_job set state = #{state}, percent = #{percent}, phase = #{phase}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, message = #{message}, session_id = #{sessionId}, selection_json = #{selectionJson}, logs_json = #{logsJson}, packed_bytes = #{packedBytes}, max_total_bytes = #{maxTotalBytes}, legacy_full = #{legacyFull}, update_time = #{updateTime} where job_id = #{jobId}
mapper.select: select job_id, project_id, pull_key, state, percent, phase, error_message, message, session_id, selection_json, logs_json, packed_bytes, max_total_bytes, legacy_full, create_time, update_time from sys_cloud_push_job where job_id = #{jobId}

select job_id, project_id, pull_key, state, percent, phase, error_message, message, session_id, selection_json, logs_json, packed_bytes, max_total_bytes, legacy_full, create_time, update_time from sys_cloud_push_job where project_id = #{projectId} and state in ('RUNNING', 'FAILED') order by case when state = 'RUNNING' then 0 else 1 end, update_time desc limit 1

select job_id, project_id, pull_key, state, percent, phase, error_message, message, session_id, selection_json, logs_json, packed_bytes, max_total_bytes, legacy_full, create_time, update_time from sys_cloud_push_job where state = 'RUNNING' order by update_time asc
